newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC Asset sets new management structure.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Asset sets new management structure.

text.p: HSBC Asset Management said on Thursday it has set up a new management structure to position itself for further growth.
Chief executive and chief investment officer (CIO) Paul Guidone will become deputy chairman and CIO, it said in a statement.
Robert Duggins, now Asia Pacific chief executive officer and managing director for retail, will be deputy chairman and chief executive officer, it said. He will be relocated to London.
Paul Chow, now deputy chief executive officer of Hong Kong, will become chief executive officer of Hong Kong. Chow will manage business in Hong Kong and developments in China, it said.
Chief operating officer Angela DeRosa will become chief executive officer responsible for managing business in the United States, it said.
Timings of the appointments have yet to be confirmed, a spokesman for the company said.
HSBC Asset Management is the global investment advisory and money management arm of HSBC Holdings Plc.
